VAL-BOOK-004.observed: Two identical POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations with the same Idempotency-Key UUID and identical JSON body both answered HTTP 201 with the identical reservation id rsv_d50dad2d-0d36-4459-b809-a5f5d2449ab2, confirmation code 2BHFBR and version 1. A third request with the same key and partySize mutated 2 -> 3 answered HTTP 409 {"error":"idempotency_conflict"}. sqlite: exactly 1 row in rsv_reservations for that id (and 1 for the confirmation code) and exactly 1 row in rsv_idempotency_keys for the key, status_code 200, scope 'POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations'. An extra replay after the rejected mutation returned the same id and left rsv_day_versions (42) and the date's reservation count (17) unchanged, so the replay executes no side effects.
VAL-BOOK-004.notes: Core criterion holds (same id on replay, one reservation row, one idempotency row, mutated body 409 idempotency_conflict). Two literal deviations from the contract text: the replay answers 201, not the 200 shown in the evidence line (the route always returns 201), and the stored scope is the route path 'POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations' rather than the literal 'operator_create'.

VAL-BOOK-005.observed: Slot 2026-10-20 17:30 local, partySize 8. Live tables/combos read first: the only compatible resources were table M6 (4-8) and combos M3+M4 and T2+T3 (5-8 each); all were occupied with locked explicit bookings. Probe without overbook: HTTP 409 {"error":"tables_occupied"}. Probe with overbook:true and no overbookReason: HTTP 400 {"error":"missing_overbook_reason"}. Probe with overbook:true + overbookReason 'VIP manager override' + explicit tableIds [tbl_acme_m6]: HTTP 201 with overbook=true; sqlite rsv_table_occupancies holds one active row for tbl_acme_m6 with overbook=1 overlapping the non-overbook blocker occupancy (the overlap trigger was bypassed for that row only); rsv_reservation_events has the created event with data {"partySize":8,"localStartMin":1050,"tableIds":["tbl_acme_m6"],"overbook":true}; rsv_audit_log has one row action='reservation.overbook', entity_id = the new reservation, changes = {"reason":"VIP manager override","partySize":8,"localStartMin":1050,"tableIds":["tbl_acme_m6"]} with zero guest PII (scan for the guest's phone/email/name tokens returned 0 matches; only keys reason/partySize/localStartMin/tableIds).
VAL-BOOK-005.notes: Neither code string named in the contract appeared: the full-slot rejection is 409 with the engine's 'tables_occupied' (not 'no_availability'), and the missing-reason rejection is HTTP 400 'missing_overbook_reason' (not 409). The three required behaviors all hold: a reason is required, the explicit overbook writes rsv_table_occupancies.overbook=1, and the audit row carries no guest PII.

A second walk-in with a NEW key and tableIds [tbl_acme_m1] (the table seated by the first walk-in, overlapping window) answered HTTP 409 {"error":"table_occupied","message":"Table M1 is currently occupied"}.
VAL-BOOK-007.notes: Core criterion holds (replay returns the first walk-in's id with no duplicate rows; occupied-table walk-in 409). Literal deviations: the scope value is the route path 'POST /operator/reservations/book/walk-ins', not 'walk_in', and the replay answers 201 rather than the 200 in the contract's evidence line.

VAL-BOOK-018.observed: All four illegal transitions answered HTTP 409 {"error":"invalid_status_transition"}: booked -> finished, finished -> arrived, no_show -> arrived, cancelled -> seated. sqlite after the attempts: the targets kept their status and version (booked reservation stayed version 1, finished stayed 5, no_show 2, cancelled 2) and their event logs contain only the created event plus the valid transition that produced the state (no bogus arrived/finished/seated events).

VAL-BOOK-019.observed: Two booked reservations with active occupancies on 2026-10-20 (rsv_e6a2c3c9... on tbl_acme_b1, rsv_5687cbcd... on tbl_acme_p1). POST /status cancelled with reason 'Guest called to cancel' -> 200: rsv_reservations rows show cancelled_at set, cancelled_by 'restaurant', cancel_reason 'Guest called to cancel', and its occupancy active=0. VAL-BOOK-021.observed: (A) A seated reservation finished at T: POST /undo -> HTTP 200, status back to seated, finished_at cleared, occupancy reactivated (active=1, end_at extended), guest visits 1 -> 0 and covers 4 -> 0. (B) Re-finished (HTTP 200) and, via the authorized single-row UPDATE below, finished_at moved 31 minutes into the past: POST /undo -> HTTP 409 {"error":"undo_window_expired","message":"Cannot undo finished status more than 30 minutes after completion"}, reservation still finished (version 7). (C) A second seated->finished reservation whose table was then taken by another booking (POST /book/reservations with explicit tableIds -> 201): POST /undo -> HTTP 409 {"error":"table_occupied"}, reservation still finished.
VAL-BOOK-021.notes: Authorized single-row SQL executed exactly once, verbatim: UPDATE rsv_reservations SET finished_at = 1792191422338 WHERE id = 'rsv_10720019-5d16-4075-ae85-62f2ac2eae93'; (1792191422338 = request time 1792193282348 minus 31*60*1000). No other row or table was written by shell. Both rejection paths named in the contract were exercised.

VAL-BOOK-022.observed: Location live with contact_statuses_enabled=1. On a booked reservation: POST /contact-status {contactStatus:'left_message'} -> 200 (stored contact_status 'left_message', event contact_status); POST /running-late {note:'Running 15 min late'} -> 200 (running_late_min parsed to 15, event running_late); POST /notes {internalNotes,dietaryNotes} -> 200 (staff_notes and dietary_notes persisted, event note). After POST /status arrived -> 200, POST /contact-status -> 409 {"error":"invalid_state_for_contact_status"} and POST /running-late -> 409 {"error":"invalid_state_for_running_late"} with the stored fields unchanged. With contact_statuses_enabled=0 (PUT settings, expectedVersion 7 -> version 8), POST /contact-status on a booked reservation -> 409 {"error":"contact_statuses_disabled"}. The setting was restored to true (version 9).
VAL-BOOK-022.notes: Setting restored to its pre-change value (contact_statuses_enabled 1).

VAL-BOOK-023.observed: With course_statuses_enabled=1: POST /course-status {course:'appetizer'} on a booked reservation -> 409 {"error":"invalid_state_for_course_status"}; after POST /status seated -> 200, the six steps appetizer, entree, dessert, check_dropped, paid, bussing each answered 200 and updated rsv_reservations.course_status (appetizer, entree, dessert, check_dropped, paid, bussing) while bumping version 3..8, each appending an event. With course_statuses_enabled=0 (PUT settings, expectedVersion 9 -> version 10) another course-status -> 409 {"error":"course_statuses_disabled"} and course_status stayed 'bussing'. Setting restored to true (version 11).
VAL-BOOK-023.notes: The appended events have type 'course' (data {"courseStatus":...,"dbCourseStatus":...}), not 'course_changed' as the contract's pass text names; no 'course_changed' string exists anywhere in the repo. Behavior (only while seated and only when the setting is on) matches exactly.

VAL-BOOK-024.observed: GET /book/day?locationId=v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8&date=2026-10-20 -> 200 with ETag "v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8:2026-10-20:35:11" (dayVersion 35, settingsVersion 11, shortEtag "35.11"). Replying with If-None-Match set to that ETag -> 304 Not Modified with a zero-byte body (the short form "35.11" is accepted too). After creating a booking on the date (HTTP 201) the stale If-None-Match returned 200 with ETag "...:36:11" (dayVersion 35 -> 36, matching rsv_day_versions) and a full body. After a PUT location-settings write (maxActivePerPhone 3 -> 4, settings version 11 -> 12) the previous ETag returned 200 with ETag "...:36:12" (settingsVersion bumped, dayVersion unchanged). maxActivePerPhone restored to 3 (version 13).
VAL-BOOK-024.notes: The served ETag is the longer composite "<locationId>:<businessDate>:<dayVersion>:<settingsVersion>" rather than the contraction "<dayVersion>.<settingsVersion>" quoted in the contract; both components move as specified and the short form is still honoured for If-None-Match.

VAL-BOOK-025.observed: GET /book/changes?locationId=...&date=2026-10-20&since=36 with no intervening write -> 200 {"dayVersion":36,"changed":false}. After PATCH /book/reservations/rsv_ea5952ed... {durationMin:105} -> 200 (version 2), the same URL with since=36 -> 200 {"dayVersion":37,"changed":true} and rsv_day_versions showed 37.

friction.description: VAL-BOOK-005 needs a genuinely full slot. For a party of 8 the only compatible resources on the live floor were table M6 (4-8) and the two combos M3+M4 and T2+T3 (5-8); all had to be occupied with LOCKED explicit bookings first, otherwise the planner can reflow soft blockers and the slot never becomes full.
friction.resolution: Read the live table/combos list, occupied M6, M3+M4 and T2+T3 with lock:true explicit bookings at 2026-10-20 17:30, then ran the negative probe (409) and the explicit overbook.
